behavior: Extra plain shortcut taps after a friendly self-cast keep targeting unselected until the cast midpoint.
A fresh double-tap at or after the midpoint may queue one follow-up; its own burst cannot add a third cast.
The guard covers duplicate spell slots, self/portrait confirmation, pending stamina and unacknowledged requests.
The clock follows simulation time and original snapshot start timestamps, including paused/slow and replica casts.
Other spell selection, explicit modified quick-casts and the disabled shortcut retain their behavior.
